source: HR/RR: AHA PALS + Red Cross PALS 2025 reference card (awake ranges). Temp: fever ≥38.0°C. SpO2: ≥95% normal. BP: AAP 2017 CPG Table 6 simplified screening table (90th %ile at 5th height %ile, NPV >99% — screening only, NOT diagnosis) + adolescent staging.
verification: PENDING — clinician verification before real-world use. Notes: infant HR upper 180 (Red Cross 2025/Cleveland Clinic; some PALS tables say 190); toddler HR band (1–2y sources) applied to 1–<3y; neonate RR 30–60 (Red Cross 2025 says 35–55).

bpScreen.note: AAP 2017 Table 6: sys/dia at or above which the child needs repeat measurement + full percentile tables. No screening threshold under 1 year.
